_: The account structure: who exists. Codes only — names/numbers NEVER live here (names flow from private runs; numbers live in Actions secrets as MOBILE_MESSAGE_TO_<CODE> for the kid seat and MOBILE_MESSAGE_PARENTS_<CODE> for that kid's parent seat). targets_alias = quiz another student's curriculum (test players). play_url = the kid's permanent Netlify quiz link (public; appended to the daily nudge so it's one tap). kid_comms_via = 'parents' redirects a kid seat WITHOUT a number of its own to that kid's parent seat (explicit per-seat opt-in, resolved in notify.py; a real TO_<CODE> secret always wins).
